races.paceDynamic: Devious Devan will lead from the gates with Fumbleinthejungle potentially pressing early, but both carry warnings for fading in the finish which creates a false pace scenario. The majority field of hold-up horses (Prince Ali, Al Baahy, Bossy Parker, Shielas Well, Angel's Call, Street Dancer) will be content to sit off what appears a modest gallop. This sets up perfectly for the late-running brigade who can time their challenges, as the early pace-setters are unlikely to sustain their efforts to the line. The race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can quicken off a steady tempo.

scenarios.body: The pace collapses allowing the large contingent of hold-up runners to unleash finishing kicks. Bossy Parker and Al Baahy benefit most from their proven finishing ability on this surface.

scenarios.body: His proven finishing kick on standard going gives him the edge over rivals who haven't won recently. The modest pace plays directly into his hands as the best closer in the field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Devious Devan Sustains Lead
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runner defies his recent fading pattern and maintains his gallop
scenarios.body: The honest pace he sets becomes genuinely testing rather than false, preventing the hold-up horses from mounting their usual late charges. His higher rating gives him the class edge if staying on.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Al Baahy Bounces Back
scenarios.trigger: If the recent winner can overcome his latest disappointing effort and return to winning form
scenarios.body: His solid record on similar going and distance gives him the tactical advantage in a slowly-run affair. The hold-up style perfectly suits the likely collapse of early pace.

This race shape clearly favors front-running tactics, as Lexington Express faces no early harassment and can control the tempo throughout.
